sentences.text:
Sk,J
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.7448 Of 2013
Order:

1. This Writ Petition is filed questioning the action of the respondents in trying to acquire the subjects lands of the petitioners covered by various survey numbers situated at Shayampet Jagir,
Hanumakonda Mandal of Warangal District for the purpose of laying road from RTC tyre Retarding Company, Hunter Road to Railway Track through the subject lands of the petitioners without initiating the proceedings under the Land Acquisition proceedings and without paying any compensation.

2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioners and the learned Assistant Government Pleader Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents.
3. While admitting the Writ Petition this Court passed interim orders on 13.03.2013 directing the respondents not to dispossess the petitioners from SK,J their respective lands, except by following due process of law.
In spite of lapse of more than eleven years the respondents did not chose file vacate petition or counter-affidavit denying the averments made by the petitioners.

4. In view of the same this Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioners over the subject lands, without following due process of law.

If the respondents wants to acquire the land of the petitioners they have to follow the procedure as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
